sentences.text:
(BY SRI. VIJAYAKUMAR MAJAGE, ADDL. S.P.P.)
 THIS CRIMINAL PETITION IS FILED UNDER SECTION 482 OF CR.P.C. PRAYING TO QUASH THE REGISTRATION OF THE CRIMINAL CASE AGAINST THE PETITIONERS FOR THE OFFENCES P/U/S 7(1), 16(1)(A) OF PREVENTION OF FOOD ADULTERATION ACT, AND RULES, ON THE BASIS OF THE COMPLAINT LODGED BY THE 2ND RESPONDENT AND ALLOW THE PETITION.

THIS CRIMINAL PETITION COMING ON FOR ADMISSION THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

Learned counsel for the petitioners has filed a memo seeking leave of this Court to withdraw the petition.
2. Memo is placed on record.
Accordingly, the petition is dismissed as withdrawn.
In view of the dismissal of the petition, I.A.No.1/2017 does not survive for consideration and disposed of accordingly.
